cards.name: Pepe the King Prawn
cards.caption: Me after pulling 5 commons
cards.flavor: Dec 2024: TikTok paired the Muppet's blank stare with stories you wish you could unsee.
cards.art: Real image: KYM's main image, the blurry close-up of Pepe the King Prawn (The Muppets) staring blankly, red hair and antenna up, apron on.

cards.name: Cheeseball the Wizard
cards.caption: Knows one spell: nap
cards.flavor: Aug 2024: an AI pic of a chubby orange cat in a wizard hat. Korean X named him Cheeseball.
cards.art: Real image: the right panel of KYM's main image, the AI-generated fat orange cat in a grey pointy wizard hat, gripping a wooden staff in a dark forest.

cards.name: Olympic Muffins
cards.caption: Insane 11/10, per Norway
cards.flavor: Paris 2024: swimmer Henrik Christiansen's TikToks made a village muffin the real gold.
cards.art: Real image: the middle panel of KYM's main image, the Olympic Village double-chocolate muffin in a brown paper tulip wrapper, chocolate chunks on top, on white.

cards.name: Shikanoko Nokonoko
cards.caption: Antlers: 1, Door: 0
cards.flavor: July 2024: Nokotan's deer girl smashed into class, and her theme song took over TikTok.
cards.art: Real image: KYM's main image, an anime still of Noko Shikanoko with her antlers, smiling cat-mouthed as she breaks through the classroom door and wall.

cards.name: Pommel Horse Guy
cards.caption: Arrive. Pommel. Leave.
cards.flavor: Paris 2024: Stephen Nedoroscik waited all night, eyes shut, did one routine, won bronze.
cards.art: Real image: the face from KYM's main image, a TV frame of gymnast Stephen Nedoroscik leaning back with his eyes closed behind sparkly glasses.

cards.name: Triangle Factory
cards.caption: A circle?? In here??
cards.flavor: Aug 2024: @MeatMarket__'s MS Paint comic about a factory worker who just rolls with it.
cards.art: Real image: KYM's main image, the MS Paint panel of a hard-hat worker by a conveyor of red triangles and one blue circle, captioned 'i guess we doin circles now'.

cards.name: Bro Visited His Friend
cards.caption: Bro opened a pack
cards.flavor: Mar 2024: @fallenchungus's bit: repeat what someone said, but put 'bro' at the start.
cards.art: Real image: the right half of @fallenchungus's MS Paint comic (KYM's main image), a grinning blob saying 'bro visited his friend'.

cards.name: Shrimp Jesus
cards.caption: Type Amen if you see it
cards.flavor: Early 2024: Facebook spam pages flooded feeds with AI art. Shrimp Jesus became its mascot.
cards.art: Real image: the Facebook AI image used by The Guardian, a haloed Jesus whose body and arms are made of shrimp, floating underwater among small fish.

cards.name: I Am Steve
cards.caption: He is, in fact, Steve
cards.flavor: Sept 2024: the Minecraft movie teaser zoomed in on Jack Black. The internet never healed.
cards.art: Real image: KYM's main image, the teaser trailer frame of Jack Black as Steve, grey-bearded in a teal shirt, staring into the camera in a blocky landscape.

cards.name: Willy Wonka Experience
cards.caption: Catgacating, as advertised
cards.flavor: Feb 2024, Glasgow: AI flyers promised a candy paradise. Guests got a near-empty warehouse.
cards.art: Real image: the AI-generated promo art from the event's flyer: a top-hatted showman among giant lollipops under an 'ENCHERINING ENTERTAINMENT' banner.

cards.name: Yusuf Dikeç
cards.caption: Hand in pocket. Silver.
cards.flavor: Paris 2024: Turkey's Yusuf Dikeç won silver in a T-shirt, no gear, one hand in his pocket.
cards.art: Real image: the photo half of KYM's main image, Yusuf Dikeç in glasses and a white TÜRKIYE shirt, aiming his air pistol one-handed, other hand in his pocket.

cards.name: Brat Summer
cards.caption: Blurry Arial, max aura
cards.flavor: Charli XCX's lime cover ruled summer 2024. Collins named 'brat' its Word of the Year.
cards.art: Real image: the Brat album cover (Charli XCX, 2024), the lowercase word 'brat' in slightly blurred black Arial on a flat lime-green square.
